scope: Retained 14-field snapshot and native response_item collector only; no live readiness/stop claim
expected_source: literal normal exec of the supplied approved binary, exact directory and nonce; mutations use shell exec and inherited CODEX_THREAD_ID; yielded output must join a previously observed retained session
schema_green: 4 tests passed; exact keys/types, expected owner/nonce, bounded steps/timestamps and liveness_checked=false; private unknown fields and error codes rejected
collector_green: 3 tests passed; recognized command and process join preserve typed snapshots, unrelated tool lookalike has no snapshot, reasoning/private bodies omitted
known_limits: Only one text(await tools.exec_command|write_stdin({literal options})) wrapper is supported; unknown code produces hashes only. PID creation identity separately uses bounded ps second-resolution timestamps. This fixture does not claim a general JavaScript parser or process-tree guard.
review_red: 3 bad snapshot time subcases plus 5 binary/window subcases reproduced before fixes
review_green: 4 snapshot tests and 5 collector tests pass; approved persistent binary path/SHA positive verified once
snapshot_times: exact nanosecond ordering and no future values; historical segment timestamps remain permitted
observation_window: each phase separately: explicit UTC, elapsed, duration >0 and <=120 seconds
binary_binding: fixed reviewed persistent path and SHA256 at collector entry; safe_input rejects any other expected path; live execution version still requires separate observer evidence
